_extraction_note: extraction-by-restoration works for the late-stack capitalization ensemble (2.9x, S1503) but FAILS for mid-stack punctuation circuits (negative class recovery, S1512) — input paths required; S1514: mid-stack heads work when layers 0-6 attention is exact, but that is non-selective — minimal input-path search open; S1516: inputs form in layers 0-3 (early>late 3/3) but whole-layer restoration is a shared trunk — sub-layer feeder search open
_method_note: complementary discovery: cosine-normalized target attribution (output-defined circuits) + attention-to-source patterns (attention-defined); sink confound closed S1524. Selectivity > 50x requires NR=1920 verification (S1523).
_movers_note: heads {5.5, 10.8} are the shared context-matching movers of induction and content-copying (S1521-22)
_unification_note: S1527 CONFIRMED: the 13-head L13-17 committee is the late-stack COPYING apparatus (damage 4.8x concentrated on copied targets; copies non-names too). S1528: head 5.5 is a SEPARATE generic copy/induction channel — two copying channels, not one pipeline. S1546: the committee is the general proper-name prediction apparatus — copying dominant, novel-name channel via 13.0/13.5.

_discovery_compression_ranking.verdict: weights-only wins both axes (6/8 damage, 5/8 selectivity); raw attribution barely clears the 2x selectivity floor; pattern-based scoring still required for context-defined circuits (copy/induction)

leg3_unit_truncation_preservation.verdict: top-K unit compression is circuit-safe; caveat: frequency-flavored class rises inflate under truncation

_mlp_unit_membership.finding: CERTIFIED MLP-unit circuit component: 16 hidden units of mlp11 (0.35% of layer) carry a .091 question-mark CE effect at 182.6x selectivity, NR=1920, replicated on a disjoint corpus slice to 0.2%. Pronouns@mlp17 is the diffuse contrast case (K16 only 30% of K64; 4.3x). Weight-side unit ranking fails (signed units); only data-driven class-conditional scoring works.
_mlp_unit_membership.implication: circuits are predominantly attention-head objects (head rises .1-2.1 vs unit rises <=.09) but sub-MLP membership is real and sharply selective for some classes
_mlp_unit_membership.eigen_slice_update: 2026-08-26 CERTIFIED: question@mlp11 component = rank-2 eigen slice of the class-projected quadratic form — class rise .180 at global rise -.0002 (zero cost), NR=1920, held-out slice within 4%. Cleanest single circuit component at any grain. NOT universal (S1574): late-layer (mlp17) spectra are sign-interleaved — slices mix gate and payload, units win at diffuse same-sign sites (is/months). Signed-part split + joint head+slice circuit tests queued. Ledger S1570-S1574.
_mlp_unit_membership.signed_slice_and_joint: 2026-08-26: (1) signed split S=S+−S− resolves mlp17 into per-class (payload, gate) eigen-pairs — pronouns payload +.12 at zero cost inside a −.29 gate; is pure payload .30; rank-8 suffices; signed slices beat units at 2/4 late sites (S1575). (2) FIRST cross-module-type circuit: question = 5 heads {10.5,12.6,15.6,15.1,9.7} + rank-2 mlp11 slice, 99.4% additive, slice marginal .166 at zero added global cost (S1576). Circuits extend beyond attention at the canonical slice grain.

joint_circuits.note: question/pronouns ~100% additive; is/months 84% (a ~16% head<->slice overlap at the late site; leave-one-out attribution in flight). Gates fully class-private at output AND computation level (S1577/S1579); single z-direction mean-substitution is the strongest gate handle (the@mlp17: one direction = -.174, 2x the output-side r8 correction).

_mlp_unit_membership.gate_naming: 2026-08-26: the mlp17 gates are NAMED axes - the-gate IS the determiner-prediction axis (token [ the] rank #1 of 50257 by unembedding alignment; class effect 1.57 std; AUC .922): self-inhibition on the class own axis. pronouns-gate = the she<->he gender contrast axis. REVISION (S1585): the serial-routing claim for the is-circuit was refuted at z-level (payload elevation drops only 16% under head substitution) - model = parallel pathways + CE saturation. Gate function (S1586): blunt precision damper - removal damage 44x concentrated at almost-the positions; suppresses true (+22%) and false (+33%) positives alike. S1583-S1586.
_mlp_unit_membership.gender_committee: 2026-08-26: the signed gender readout at mlp17 is a 64-unit committee (1.4% of the layer) reproducing 101% of the .49-CE reflection effect; axis-specific (random-direction control .013). Reflected he-state hedges to NEUTRAL referents (the/they/it), not she - asymmetric gender coding. S1589/S1590. Extraction-property tests for the question and pronoun circuits in flight.

_extraction_asymmetry.finding: removal-certified 5-head circuits recover only .159 (question) / .230 (pronouns) of their class attention gap when all other heads are optimal-constant substituted (MLPs intact); selective (3-6x over global recovery) and 3-4x over random-5 controls. Removal certifies announcers; extraction requires the distributed context assembly. Gender readout depth-localized to mlp17 (20:1 vs mlp13-16).
_extraction_asymmetry.implication: extraction difficulty is the correct price signal for compression-helps-circuits; extraction-vs-K curve and compressed-background extraction in flight
_extraction_asymmetry.resolution: 2026-08-26: extraction against a DEAD (optimal-constant) background is structurally capped and non-monotone (.16/.32/.23/.40 at K=5/10/20/40 — S1334 inversion: mid-rank heads harmful without context). COMPRESSION IS EXTRACTION: the rank-32 whitened-QK background alone preserves 97% of question class function (rise .19 vs 6.0 under constants) and exact circuit heads add nothing (-.08 marginal). A compression class-CE preservation number IS its extraction score. S1593/S1594; rank sweep + pronouns confirmation in flight.

pronouns_compressed_background.finding: compression-is-extraction confirmed on pronouns; exact circuit heads inside the compressed background are ANTI-extraction (mixed-fidelity patching breaks the self-consistent compressed pattern field)
